name: Complementary eyeshadow for iris color

lead: This is a makeup tip: choose eyeshadow shades opposite your iris color on the color wheel so the eyes look more vivid.
It is based on color-theory reasoning, and no studies of its effect on perceived attractiveness were found.

paras: Contrasting hues placed near the eye are said to increase the perceived saturation of the iris through simultaneous contrast.
No specific risks beyond general cosmetic precautions such as product allergies or irritation.

lead: Complementary eyeshadow for iris color is a makeup approach in which shadow colors are chosen to contrast with the eye's iris hue, on the color-wheel idea that opposite hues intensify each other. Practitioners say it makes the iris stand out.
infobox: Make the iris color stand out

paras: Common examples cited in makeup advice pair warm tones such as bronze or copper with blue eyes. This reflects general color-theory reasoning used by makeup artists; the claims here are those of practitioners, and no published research on this specific practice was identified.
